name: Functional Testing
purpose: Identify functional test scenarios that are directly supported by the provided requirements.

apply_when: The requirement describes a user action and expected system behavior.
The requirement describes a business rule.
The requirement describes a validation rule.
The requirement describes a state change.
The requirement describes an input or output behavior.
do_not_apply_when: The behavior is not present in the supplied requirements or project documents.
The scenario would require inventing a business rule.
The scenario would require inventing an unsupported system behavior.

coverage_dimensions.name: Positive Behavior
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify the explicitly supported successful behavior.

coverage_dimensions.name: Negative Behavior
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify behavior when an explicitly defined rule is violated.

coverage_dimensions.name: Input Validation
coverage_dimensions.description: Validate inputs when the requirement defines input rules or constraints.

coverage_dimensions.name: Required Fields
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify required-field behavior when a field is explicitly required.

coverage_dimensions.name: Optional Fields
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify optional-field behavior when optionality is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Boundary Conditions
coverage_dimensions.description: Test boundaries derived from explicitly stated minimum or maximum constraints.

coverage_dimensions.name: Error Handling
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly specified error behavior and failure outcomes.

coverage_dimensions.name: Workflow
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify each materially distinct workflow path described by the requirement.

coverage_dimensions.name: State Transition
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify state changes explicitly described by the requirement.

unknown_information.rule: Missing information must not be silently invented.
